rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for remembering or recalling something.

example.english: I recollect that you used to live here.
example.traditional: 我記得你以前住喺呢度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gei3 dak1 nei5 ji5 cin4 zyu6 hai2 ni1 dou6

rows.note: Use this when actively calling a past event, fact, or reason back to mind.

example.english: I recollect now that the shop was closed that day because it rained heavily.
example.traditional: 我諗返起喇，嗰日係因為落大雨所以冇開舖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 faan1 hei2 laa3 go2 jat6 hai6 jan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 so2 ji5 mou5 hoi1 pou3

rows.note: Use this mainly in reflective or more formal descriptions of thinking back over past events.

example.english: When I recollect that period, I still feel very warm inside.
example.traditional: 回想嗰段日子，我仍然覺得好溫暖。
example.jyutping: wui4 soeng2 go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2 ngo5 jing4 jin4 gok3 dak1 hou2 wan1 nyun5
